_comment: The opening film's voice-over. Separate from script-keuken.json because it belongs to no room — VoiceBank loads every bundled script-*.json, so a new room or scene is a new file here rather than an edit to an existing one. Same format, same rules.

_timing._comment: One line per shot, written to the length of that shot. Measured, not guessed: Gracie delivers Dutch at roughly 15-17 characters a second, so a line's character count predicts its duration to within a few tenths. Re-cut a shot and the line to match it — the numbers below are the working budget.
_timing._note: The 1.27s before the cut is deliberate. She asks 'kom je mee naar binnen?' and then we cut inside — the pause is the answer. Wall-to-wall narration would be worse, not better.

_line_ids._comment: One variant each on purpose: an opening should sound the same every time, the way a title card does. The film is silent, so this is all she hears. luna.intro.keuken fires on the cut between shots rather than on a timer.
_line_ids.luna.intro.buiten: Over the exterior shot. Names the bakery, names Luna, and makes Nina the baker.
_line_ids.luna.intro.keuken: Over the interior shot, from the cut.

variants.text: Welkom in Nina's toverbakkerij! Hier woon ik, Luna. En jij bent de bakker. Kom je mee naar binnen?
Dit is de keuken. Hier bakken we de allerlekkerste tovertaarten. Zullen we beginnen?
